caption:
# Visual Studio Code GUI Interface Description

## Window Header and System Information

- **Application Title Bar**: Displays "Visual Studio Code" on the left, "Welcome - my_flask_app - Visual Studio Code" in the center, and window control buttons (minimize, maximize, close) on the right.
- **System Information Bar**: Located at the top center, displays "Oct 23 01:12" with a bell icon indicating notifications.
- **Desktop Environment Indicator**: "Activities" is visible on the top-left corner, indicating the GNOME desktop environment.
- **System Tray**: Located on the top-right corner, contains icons for network, sound, and power.

## Menu Bar

- **Main Menu Items**: File, Edit, Selection, View, Go, Run, Terminal, Help.
- **Active Menu**: The "File" menu is currently active, with its dropdown visible.
- **File Menu Dropdown**: Contains options for "New File...", "Open File...", "Open Folder...", and "Connect to...".

## Left Sidebar (Activity Bar)

- **Explorer Icon**: A folder icon, currently active, with the label "EXPLORER" above it.
- **File Explorer Content**: Displays the folder structure for "MY_FLASK_APP" with the following items:
  - "templates" (folder)
  - "app.py" (file)
  - "README.md" (file)
  - "requirements.txt" (file)
- **Other Icons (from top to bottom)**:
  - Search icon
  - Source Control icon
  - Debug icon
  - Extensions icon
  - Git icon
  - Terminal icon
  - Settings icon (with a notification badge showing "1")
  - Outline icon
  - Timeline icon
  - User profile icon
  - Grid icon (application launcher)

## Main Content Area

- **Welcome Tab**: The "Welcome" tab is active, with a close button (X) next to it.
- **Welcome Page Title**: "Visual Studio Code" in large font, followed by the tagline "Editing evolved".
- **Start Section**:
  - "New File..." with a plus icon and a tooltip indicating "Ctrl + N".
  - "Open File..." with an open folder icon.
  - "Open Folder..." with a folder icon.
  - "Connect to..." with a cloud icon.
- **Recent Section**:
  - Text: "You have no recent folders, open a folder to start."
- **Walkthroughs Section**:
  - "Get Started with VS Code" with a star icon and description: "Customize your editor, learn the basics, and start coding". This option is highlighted with a blue underline.
  - "Learn the Fundamentals" with a lightbulb icon.
- **Settings Checkbox**: "Show welcome page on startup" is checked.

## Floating Dialog Box

- **Title**: "New File..."
- **Input Field**: "Select File Type or Enter File Name..." with a text input box.
- **File Type Options**:
  - "Text File" with "Built-In" label and "Ctrl + N" shortcut.
  - "Jupyter Notebook" with "ipynb Support" label.
- **Action Buttons**: "File" and "Notebook" buttons are visible.

## Bottom Status Bar

- **Status Indicators**: Displays "0" for errors, warnings, and other indicators.
- **Icons**: Includes a gear icon, a checkmark icon, and a notification icon.

## Right Sidebar (Activity Bar)

- **Window Control Buttons**: Minimize, maximize, and close buttons are visible on the top-right corner.
- **More Options Button**: Three dots (ellipsis) button for additional options.

## Additional UI Elements

- **Application Icons**: A vertical dock on the left side of the screen contains various application icons, including Chrome, Firefox, Visual Studio Code, VLC, LibreOffice, GIMP, and others.
- **System Icons**: Located on the top-right corner, including network, sound, and power icons.
